verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers option grant retrieval, draft option grant creation, and cap table endpoints, but nothing documents defining custom vesting schedules (cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit) or automatic tracking of vested versus unvested amounts. Vesting schedules are a fair axis for a cap table and equity-management product, so the missing evidence yields "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define custom vesting schedules — cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit — and the platform tracks vested vs unvested automatically
